=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1734-1736 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: When `REVIEW_RUNS_JSON` is captured successfully but the piped jq filter fails (e.g. a malformed API response with valid HTTP status), the `2>/dev/null || echo ""` fallback silently produces an empty `REVIEW_RUN`, which is indistinguishable from "no review run found."
  WHY: A malformed branch-listing payload that jq rejects causes an extra poll iteration with no diagnostic, delaying detection that the listing is producing invalid data. The poll continues until the timeout or until a working listing is returned, but the operator never sees the failure mode.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1712 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: Phase 4 leg (c) compares `BUG_B_SHA` (always lowercase from the helper) against `PIN_SHA` / `BAIT_SHA` without case normalization.
  WHY: If BAIT_SHA were ever uppercased (allowed by the validation regex), the Phase 4 leg (c) comparison would silently fail to match the legitimate lowercase SHA from the helper, preventing a completed Bug B run from ever advancing to "verified" and keeping the poll waiting.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

  WHY: Suggested minimal fix: Change comparison to [ "${BUG_B_SHA}" = "${PIN_SHA,,}" ] || [ "${BUG_B_SHA}" = "${BAIT_SHA,,}" ] for consistency.
